method: Editorial comparisons between exact public works; all destinations returned HTTP 200, canonical indexable pages. No shared-series relationship is inferred. All thirty directed links were absent from the pre-change HTML. Source pages and locale are guarded before rendering; canonical targets are live-audited after release.

edges.label: Out of Darkness

edges.label: Nineteen Minutes

edges.label: Secrets of The lost symbol

edges.label: Welcome to Dead House

edges.label: Beware!
